notes.title: Steam Awards: Nominate Us For Best Soundtrack!
notes.content: The Game Awards done goofed by not nominating us for an award... so now it's time to make it happen at the Steam Awards! Be sure to drop by our Steam page and nominate us for "Best Soundtrack". And while you're at it, be sure to pick up a copy of our album The Pursuit of Money while it's 15% off!
